name: Categorized App List with Status Dots
description: App link cards grouped into categories, each with a live status dot. Docker apps show container state (green running, red exited/dead, orange other); others can get an HTTP check (green up, orange 4xx/5xx, red 502-504 or unreachable, gray checking). Hover a dot for details. Order and grouping come from each app's description: NN-CATEGORY-NN (e.g. 02-MEDIA-01). Needs Homarr 2.0+, an admin API key and Docker set up in Homarr. Point the API source at your Homarr URL (not localhost).

pingFallback.label: HTTP check for apps without a container
pingFallback.description: For apps with no matching Docker container, ping the app's ping URL (or link) through Homarr. All checks go out as one batched request (up to 24 apps), cached for 60 seconds. Off: those apps show no dot.

showUncategorized.label: Show apps without a category
showUncategorized.description: Apps whose description is not NN-CATEGORY-NN go in an "Other" group at the bottom. They ignore "Categories to show", so if you split categories across several widgets, turn this on in only one. Off: those apps are hidden.

containerOverrides.label: Container name overrides
containerOverrides.description: Only needed when a container name differs from the app name. Comma-separated app=container pairs, e.g. immich=immich-server, paperless=paperless-ngx. Case, spaces and dashes are ignored.

fuzzyMatch.label: Fuzzy container matching
fuzzyMatch.description: Also match a container whose name is contained in the app name. Can give wrong matches (e.g. Plexamp to plex), so it is off by default. Prefer 'Container name overrides'. Extra work: past ~40 apps it can hit Homarr's template limit.

categoryColumns.label: Category columns
categoryColumns.description: Up to this many category columns side by side (1-6). Empty columns are dropped, so you never get more columns than categories. 1 is the classic single list.

saveSpace.label: Save space
saveSpace.description: With 2+ columns, put each category in the shortest column so the widget stays as short as possible. Category order may shift between columns. Off: categories fill columns left to right in order.

template:
<Stack gap="6px" w="100%">
  {!status.apps?.loading && !status.apps?.error && status.containers?.error ? (
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" ta="center">
      Docker status unavailable{options.pingFallback ? ", using HTTP checks" : ""}.
    </Text>
  ) : null}
  {status.apps?.loading || status.containers?.loading ? (
    <Skeleton height={200} radius="md" />
  ) : status.apps?.error ? (
    <Alert color="red" title="Could not load apps">
      <Text size="sm">{status.apps.error}</Text>
      <Text size="xs" mt="xs">
        {"Check that an API token is set (Management > Tools > AI & MCP > Authentication > Create API token), that it's added under the ApiKey header, and that the API source points at your Homarr URL, not localhost."}
      </Text>
    </Alert>
  ) : (
    [
      {
        containers: (data.containers?.result?.data?.json?.containers ?? []).map((c) => ({
          key: (c.name ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ""),
          state: c.state ?? ""
        })),
        overrides: (options.containerOverrides ?? "")
          .split(",")
          .map((pair) => pair.split("="))
          .filter((pair) => pair.length === 2)
          .map((pair) => ({
            app: pair[0].toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ""),
            container: pair[1].toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")
          })),
        apps: (Array.isArray(data.apps) ? data.apps : [])
          .map((app) => ({
            ...app,
            desc: (app.description ?? "").trim(),
            nameKey: (app.name ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")
          }))
          .map((app) => ({ ...app, first: app.desc.indexOf("-"), last: app.desc.lastIndexOf("-") }))
          .map((app) => ({
            ...app,
            catNum: Number(app.desc.substring(0, app.first)),
            catName: app.desc.substring(app.first + 1, app.last),
            order: Number(app.desc.substring(app.last + 1))
          }))
          .map((app) => ({
            ...app,
            tagged:
              app.first > 0 &&
              app.last > app.first &&
              app.desc.substring(app.last + 1) !== "" &&
              !isNaN(app.catNum) &&
              !isNaN(app.order)
          }))
          .filter((app) => app.tagged || options.showUncategorized)
          .map((app) => (app.tagged ? app : { ...app, catNum: 9999, catName: "Other", order: 0 }))
          .filter((app) =>
            !app.tagged || options.categoryRange === "all" ? true
            : options.categoryRange === "odd" ? app.catNum % 2 === 1
            : options.categoryRange === "even" ? app.catNum % 2 === 0
            : app.catNum >= Number((options.categoryRange ?? "1-99").split("-")[0]) &&
              app.catNum <= Number((options.categoryRange ?? "1-99").split("-")[1])
          )
          .sort((a, b) =>
            a.catNum - b.catNum ||
            a.catName.localeCompare(b.catName) ||
            a.order - b.order ||
            (a.name ?? "").localeCompare(b.name ?? "")
          )
      }
    ]
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        fuzzyPool: options.fuzzyMatch
          ? ctx.containers.filter((c) => c.key.length >= 4)
          : [],
        stateByKey: ctx.containers.reduce((acc, c) => (acc["k" + c.key] !== undefined ? acc : { ...acc, ["k" + c.key]: c.state }), {})
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        apps: ctx.apps.map((app) => ({
          ...app,
          containerKey: (ctx.overrides.find((o) => o.app === app.nameKey) ?? {}).container || app.nameKey
        }))
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        apps: ctx.apps.map((app) => ({
          ...app,
          state:
            ctx.stateByKey["k" + app.containerKey] ||
            (options.fuzzyMatch
              ? ctx.fuzzyPool.filter((c) => app.containerKey.includes(c.key)).reduce((best, c) => (c.key.length > best.key.length ? c : best), { key: "", state: "" }).state
              : "") ||
            ""
        }))
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        pingIds: options.pingFallback
          ? ctx.apps.filter((app) => app.state === "").map((app) => app.id).slice(0, 24)
          : []
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        apps: ctx.apps.map((app) => ({ ...app, pingIdx: ctx.pingIds.indexOf(app.id) }))
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        pingParams: {
          procs: ctx.pingIds.map((id) => "widget.app.ping").join(","),
          input: "{" + ctx.pingIds.map((id, k) => "\"" + k + "\":" + JSON.stringify({ json: { id: id } })).join(",") + "}"
        }
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        colCount: Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.round(Number(options.categoryColumns) || 1)))
      }))
      .map((ctx) => ({
        ...ctx,
        columns: ctx.apps
          .reduce(
            (acc, app) =>
              acc.length > 0 && acc[acc.length - 1].key === app.catNum + "-" + app.catName
                ? [...acc.slice(0, -1), { key: acc[acc.length - 1].key, apps: [...acc[acc.length - 1].apps, app] }]
                : [...acc, { key: app.catNum + "-" + app.catName, apps: [app] }],
            []
          )
          .reduce(
            (cols, cat, i) =>
              [options.saveSpace ? cols.reduce((min, col, j, arr) => (col.weight < arr[min].weight ? j : min), 0) : i % ctx.colCount].map((target) =>
                cols.map((col, j) => (j === target ? { weight: col.weight + 1.5 + cat.apps.length, apps: [...col.apps, { isHeader: true, id: "h-" + cat.key, catName: cat.apps[0].catName }, ...cat.apps] } : col))
              )[0],
            "0".repeat(ctx.colCount).split("").map(() => ({ weight: 0, apps: [] }))
          )
          .filter((col) => col.apps.length > 0)
      }))
      .map((ctx) =>
          ctx.apps.length === 0 ? (
            <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" ta="center" p="md">
              No apps matched. Set each app's description to NN-CATEGORY-NN, for example 02-MEDIA-01.
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <Box style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(" + ctx.columns.length + ", minmax(0, 1fr))", columnGap: "12px", alignItems: "start" }}>
              {ctx.columns.map((col, c) => (
                <Stack key={"col" + c} gap="6px" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                  {col.apps.map((app) =>
                    app.isHeader ? (
                      <Text key={app.id} fw={700} tt="uppercase" c="dimmed" fz="xs" mt="10px" mb="2px" ta="center">
                        {app.catName}
                      </Text>
                    ) : (
                <Anchor
                  key={app.id}
                  href={app.href}
                  target="_blank"
                  underline="never"
                  c="inherit"
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: "10px",
                    padding: "8px 12px",
                    borderRadius: "8px",
                    backgroundColor: "light-dark(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85), rgba(18, 19, 23, 0.85))",
                    border: "1px solid light-dark(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14))",
                    boxShadow: "0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)"
                  }}
                >
                  <Group gap={0} wrap="nowrap" align="flex-end" style={{ flex: "0 0 auto" }}>
                    <Image src={app.iconUrl} alt="" w={20} h={20} fit="contain" />
                    {app.state !== "" || app.pingIdx >= 0 ? (
                      <Box
                        w={10}
                        h={10}
                        aria-hidden={app.state !== "" ? "true" : undefined}
                        title={app.state !== "" ? "Container " + app.state : undefined}
                        style={{
                          flex: "0 0 auto",
                          marginLeft: "calc(-7px * var(--mantine-scale))",
                          marginBottom: "calc(-3px * var(--mantine-scale))",
                          borderRadius: "50%",
                          overflow: "hidden",
                          border: "calc(1.5px * var(--mantine-scale)) solid var(--mantine-color-body)"
                        }}
                      >
                        {app.state !== "" ? (
                          <Box w="100%" h="100%" style={{ backgroundColor: app.state === "running" ? "var(--mantine-color-green-6)" : app.state === "exited" || app.state === "dead" ? "var(--mantine-color-red-6)" : "var(--mantine-color-orange-6)" }} />
                        ) : (
                          <SubFetch
                            requestId="pings"
                            params={ctx.pingParams}
                            fallback={<Box w="100%" h="100%" role="img" aria-label="Checking" title="Checking..." style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--mantine-color-gray-5)" }} />}
                            errorMessage="HTTP check failed"
                          >
                            {(res) =>
                              [Number(res?.[app.pingIdx]?.result?.data?.json?.statusCode)].map((code) => (
                                <Box
                                  key="dot"
                                  w="100%"
                                  h="100%"
                                  role="img"
                                  aria-label={code >= 100 && code < 600 ? "HTTP " + code : "Unreachable"}
                                  title={code >= 100 && code < 600 ? "HTTP " + code : "Unreachable"}
                                  style={{
                                    backgroundColor:
                                      (code >= 200 && code < 400) || code === 401 || code === 403 ? "var(--mantine-color-green-6)"
                                      : code >= 502 && code <= 504 ? "var(--mantine-color-red-6)"
                                      : code >= 400 && code < 600 ? "var(--mantine-color-orange-6)"
                                      : "var(--mantine-color-red-6)"
                                  }}
                                />
                              ))
                            }
                          </SubFetch>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                    ) : null}
                  </Group>
                  <Text size="sm" fw={500} title={app.name} style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", minWidth: 0 }}>
                    {app.name}
                  </Text>
                  {app.state !== "" ? <VisuallyHidden>{"(container " + app.state + ")"}</VisuallyHidden> : null}
                </Anchor>
                    )
                  )}
                </Stack>
              ))}
            </Box>
          )
      )
  )}
</Stack>
